subject: Eligibility and Backfill: Integrata reseller commission windows & trial-conversion credits
messages:
From: Sophie Martin <sophie@integrata.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.example>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>
Date: 2026-10-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Clarify trial-conversion credits + retroactive lead credits for pilot

Hi Jonas —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Integrata is excited about the pilot bundle with Redwood (PX trial + connector). Two items we need clarity on before we finalize the mutual action plan:

1) Trial-conversion credit: for paid conversions that originate from a Redwood trial, what documentation is required to qualify for the trial-conversion credit? We have a few accounts that started with trials last quarter and converted in September.

2) Backfill/retroactive credits: because our SDRs were onboarding your registration form late, we have ~6 enterprise leads that weren’t registered but were clearly originated by Integrata. Is there a process to request a backfill credit? If so, what evidence do you need and what’s the cut-off window?

Attached: Integrata_MOP_v3.pdf (draft MOP), and a short list of sample accounts.

Can we get an internal timeline + contact names at Redwood to run an exception for our pilot cohort? Ideally we’d close this before the pilot kickoff week (wk of Nov 9).

Appreciate it —
Sophie Martin
Head of Partnerships | Integrata Solutions
S: +1 415-555-0198
[Attachment: Integrata_MOP_v3.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.example>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie@integrata.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.example>
Date: 2026-10-29T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify trial-conversion credits + retroactive lead credits for pilot

Hi Sophie —

Thanks for the clear ask. We can grant a pilot exception path but want to make the rules explicit so this scales cleanly. High-level summary:

- Trial-conversion credit: qualifies if (a) the user created a Redwood trial that maps to the Integrata-sourced lead (HubSpot source, UTM/referral or partner lead tag), and (b) conversion to paid occurs within 60 days of trial start. Required evidence: HubSpot record or account creation timestamp, and a copy of the invoice/paid receipt.

- Backfill/retroactive credit: for the pilot only we can accept backfill requests up to 120 days from the original lead creation date, limited to the pilot cohort (we’ll define list). Required evidence: Integrata lead list + audit logs showing initial outreach and demo scheduling. We’ll require a signed MOP that calls out the exception.

I’m looping in Ben (partner ops) to outline the operational steps and Camila for legal/redlines on the MOP. I’ve attached a draft commission_sheet.xlsx with the pilot rate proposals — take a look and tell us which accounts you want to include.

Next steps (proposed):
- Sophie: confirm the six candidate accounts and upload the CSV by Nov 2.
- Integrata: sign the MOP doc (we’ll send DocuSign link once legal confirms final language).
- Ben: run the exception review and reply with payment timing/terms.

Jonas Weber
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
[jonas_weber@redwood.example]
[Attachment: commission_sheet.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.example>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.example>
Date: 2026-10-30T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify trial-conversion credits + retroactive lead credits for pilot

Jonas / team —

Operational notes and constraints from partner ops:

1) Lead registration/process: Integrata must submit the backfill list via the partner lead intake form (we’ll accept CSV upload to our secure S3 link). That triggers a validation job: matching by company domain, first-touch timestamp, and CRM owner.

2) Backfill window: for this pilot we’ll allow up to 120 days as Jonas proposed, but only for leads with demonstrable initial outreach (email thread or calendar invite). After the pilot period the standard policy is 90 days.

3) Commission & payment: pilot tiers
   - Tier A (ARR > $50k): 12% commission first 90 days after paid invoice
   - Tier B (ARR $10k–$50k): 10%
   - Tier C (< $10k): 6%
Payment terms Net 45 after invoice; clawback window 12 months from payout.

4) Cap & marketing condition: we can approve a temporary uplift (see below) but require a joint marketing mention and partner-of-record tag on the account.

I’ll create a short SOP and update partner handbook after we close this. Posting the DocuSign link for MOP signature here: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/ABC-Integrata-MOP

—Ben
Ben Carter
Head, Partner Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Sophie Martin <sophie@integrata.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.example>
Cc: partners@integrata.com
Date: 2026-11-01T10:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify trial-conversion credits + retroactive lead credits for pilot

Thanks Jonas — and Ben, appreciate the clarity. A few follow-ups:

- I’ll upload the CSV of the six enterprise leads by EOD Nov 2. Attaching a work-in-progress list for visibility.
- For the temporary uplift: would Redwood consider 14% for Tier A for the first quarter of the pilot? Our SDRs will prioritize co-sell and it helps justify the campaign spend. If not 14%, can we get 12% guaranteed?
- For evidence, some of our early demos were run over shared Zoom links and recorded demos — will those recordings suffice along with email threads?

On a related note, Integrata would like the backfill approvals completed before we publicly list the integration on our marketplace (we want to avoid confused customers about eligibility).

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Sophie
[Attachment: integrata_lead_list.csv (text/csv)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.example>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie@integrata.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.example>
Date: 2026-11-03T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify trial-conversion credits + retroactive lead credits for pilot

Sophie —

Appreciate the quick follow-ups and the lead CSV. Confirming Redwood’s position for the pilot cohort: we’ll approve a one-time backfill for the six listed enterprise leads pending the evidence checklist (email thread/demo timestamps/HubSpot ID). Once validation completes we’ll process the commission as follows:

- Temporary uplift: 12% for Tier A for Q4 (capped at $120k aggregate payout across Integrata-sourced deals for the pilot).
- Trial-conversion credit: still must fall within 60 days of trial start and include invoice evidence.
- Payment & clawback: Net 45; 12-month clawback window.

Conditions: Integrata must sign the MOP and include joint marketing copy and partner-of-record tag. We’ll send the DocuSign shortly — Ben, please attach the SOP and payment routing template when you reply.

If this looks good Sophie, respond here with a one-line confirmation and we’ll start the validation run.
